exposure: etiology of PPH (e.g., poor uterine tone)
cohort: The study included women who delivered at Sultan Qaboos University Hospital between January 2017 and December 2021 and experienced postpartum hemorrhage.
finding: The prevalence of PPH was 4.0% after vaginal deliveries and 13.0% after cesarean sections, with poor uterine tone being the primary cause in both groups.
mod_finding: PPH prevalence was significantly higher after cesarean sections (13.0%) compared to vaginal deliveries (4.0%), with cesarean deliveries also requiring more blood transfusions (35.3% vs 10.2%) and having higher average blood loss.
